answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the ember is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the falcon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sable re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
